capabilities.notes: eval or synthesised code; common and often benign, and frequently bundler output
hooks the API/LLM path, so it can observe or alter provider traffic
hooks system-prompt assembly, so it can influence what the model is told
reads an environment variable whose name looks credential-shaped
patches runtime objects rather than only registering its own services
spawns or would spawn an operating-system process
watches the filesystem; a recursive workspace watch is the documented cause of host stalls
resolves a path outside the workspace (e.g. os.homedir(), DSH_HOME), which is normal for DSH profile handling; static analysis cannot determine whether it also writes there
